_notes: Ideogram 4 (local nvfp4). The prompt (node 98:24) is fed a STRUCTURED JSON caption (high_level_description + style_description + compositional_deconstruction with text elements/hex/bbox) produced by the segment_image_prompt LLM stage — Ideogram renders that far better than plain text, and it sidesteps the safety filter that tripped on bare prompts. Output aspect is set by ResolutionSelector (node 37, default '16:9 (Widescreen)'); width/height are derived, so they are not mapped here. The workflow's built-in magic-prompt scaffold (nodes 134:*) is preview-only / disconnected in the API export — the dhee LLM stage does that expansion instead.
